bio.text: Jahana Hayes was elected in November 2018 to represent Connecticut's 5th Congressional District, becoming the first African-American woman to represent Connecticut in Congress.
Before running for office she taught history for 15 years at John F. Kennedy High School in Waterbury and was named the 2016 National Teacher of the Year.
She holds degrees from Southern Connecticut State University, the University of Saint Joseph, and the University of Bridgeport, and attended Naugatuck Valley Community College.
